## Descripción original

UniAction represents any action as a sparse set of action elements, letting force, camera control, hand pose and robot pose condition one world model.

Enlaces: código: https://github.com/KBRASK/UniAction · proyecto: https://uniaction.github.io/ · pesos: https://huggingface.co/BowenXue/UniAction Mencionado en: AI Search: AI finally sleeps, Gemini 4 Carbon, ETH cracked, energy-based models, Anthropic IPO: AI NEWS

README: UniAction: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models

Action-conditioned world models are typically designed for individual action types, fragmenting scarce action-annotated data across separate models. We introduce UniAction, a unified action-conditioning framework that represents heterogeneous actions as sparse action elements, each with a discrete semantic identity and continuous spatiotemporal coordinates. These coordinates map directly into the pretrained video model's native positional space, allowing actions and video to interact within a shared spatiotemporal structure.
